violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the bar dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is not to use dishwasher until it is able to reach the proper chlorine sanitizing concentration. 3-bay sink was set-up at the time of inspection. Per PIC, service will be called. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

-The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. -Knives were observed being stored in between lowboy units. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Proper storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the bar dishwasher. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and microwave have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
